claims.object_text: female mice heterozygous for Cdkl5 mutations (mouse model)
claims.quote: seizures are specific to female mice heterozygous for Cdkl5 mutations and not observed in hemizygous knockout males or homozygous knockout females.
All patients developed seizures irrespective of their genetic status of the pathogenic variant.

claims.object_text: feeding, respiratory, and visual functional impairments
claims.quote: cellular mosaicism of CDKL5 deficiency was associated with lesser severity of other comorbidities such as feeding, respiratory, and visual functional impairments.

claims.object_text: developmental consequences arising directly from the effect of the CDKL5 pathogenic variant
claims.quote: CDD patients not only exhibited clinical features of epilepsy but also exhibited the developmental consequences arising directly from the effect of the CDKL5 pathogenic variant.
